digest.component_or_area: doctor lock census / snapshot GC subsystem
propositions: Doctor's lock census does not scan the snapshot-GC worker lock at <snapshot-store>/gc/worker.lock, leaving stale locks from dead snapshot-GC workers invisible to diagnostic
Snapshot-GC worker lock uses the same v2 stamped-ownership format and staleness adjudication (stamped_file_lock and lock_owner.stamped_file_is_stale) as drain and compact-worker locks
The snapshot-store root must be derived read-only (without mkdir/chmod side effects) in doctor's diagnostic pass to preserve the census's no-creation guarantee
The new snapshot-gc-worker census leg reports lock state (held/holder/staleness) via the shared stamped-lock table without re-deriving layout; absent store reports free
Tests must isolate the host-global snapshot-store probe with a pinned REBAR_GATE_TMPDIR fixture to prevent real host state leakage
